SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, COUNT(*) AS days, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w0, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w1
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS grp, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN r.store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS grp, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id = 999 THEN r.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS s999
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.grp, m.mine, c.ctl, c.ctl - m.mine AS gap, c.s999
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, grp) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_ids_with_not_exactly_1_current', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> 1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_orders_multi_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order_row', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_dispatched', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS cnt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, s.store_id, MIN(r.sale_date) AS first_d, MAX(r.sale_date) AS last_d, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows, SUM(r.net_amount) AS dup_net, MIN(r.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded_min, MAX(r.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded_max
FROM r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
WHERE r.cnt > 1 AND r.rn > 1
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_fiscal_not_fully_loaded_Q3', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_quarter=3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND NOT fully_loaded
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_lines_in_Q3_non_trading_days_stores', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day AND d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_etl_loaded_at_Q3_lines', CAST(MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
